cleavage agent: equal amounts of each sample was subjected to in-solution digestions with LysC and trypsin.
enrichment method: The most abundant proteins in plasma were depleted with the Agilent Plasma 14 Multiple Removal System 4.6×100
fractionation method: isoelectric focusing by immobilized pH gradient
the sample pool was subjected to peptide IEF-IPG (isoelectric focusing by immobilized pH gradient) in pI range 3–10
labeling: The resulting peptide mixtures were labeled with isobaric tandem masstags (Thermo Scientific).
